title: ‘Political activities like sit-ins, hunger strikes have no place in democracy’: Kerala HC

ai.summary: Kerala High Court ruled that political activities like sit-ins and hunger strikes have no place in constitutional democracy, particularly in academic institutions, stating educational institutions should not be used for politics.

facts.claim: Kerala High Court ruled that political activities like sit-ins and hunger strikes have no place in constitutional democracy
facts.quote: The Kerala High Court has said that “political activities” such as dharnas, or sit-ins, hunger strikes and satyagraha, or peaceful protests, have “no place in a constitutional democracy”, particularly in academic institutes

facts.claim: The court stated educational institutions should not be used for politics
facts.quote: Educational institutions are meant for imparting education and not politics," The Indian Express quoted the bench as saying.

facts.claim: Students were suspended for protesting and holding a street play that allegedly insulted the Vice Chancellor
facts.quote: The students, members of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)’s student wing, were suspended after they protested for better infrastructure and academic facilities, and held a street play that allegedly insulted Vice Chancellor Ciza Thomas in August.

ai.background_note: Kerala High Court ruled that political activities like sit-ins and hunger strikes have no place in constitutional democracy, particularly in academic institutions, stating educational institutions should not be used for politics.
